name: Gottlob Frege
biography: Credited with publishing the correct definition of 'number' in 1884 (identifying a number with a class of classes), after remaining unrecognized until Russell drew attention to his work in 1903; his discovery is said to disprove Kant's claim that arithmetical propositions are 'synthetic.'
